authorization: User explicitly confirmed independent method research and fair four-arm retraining on existing hardware; no paid resources.
prior_target_exposure: Existing target aggregate results have already been observed. No new target evaluation or target-driven candidate selection is permitted in this pilot.
selection_role_change: Independent research expands this role from original kappa/scale calibration to source-only candidate validation. It does not rewrite the original protocol.

validation.metric: Equal source-city x budget mean of bank median error in meters
validation.partition: Seeded half of unique physical source-validation positions is support-only; the remaining half is validation-only, excluding coordinate siblings across all source-validation banks.
validation.promotion: Only eligible for a larger source-only pilot if candidate Full is strictly best among all four arms in every source city/budget cell and its macro error improves over fixed-margin Full. No automatic formal retraining or SOTA claim.
